basic_info.description: Set along Sacramento Street's chic boutique corridor, this top-floor condo showcases refined, light-filled interiors. A welcoming foyer introduces the open living-dining great room centered on a travertine fireplace, where expansive south-facing windows frame sweeping city views and open to a sunny deck. The renovated kitchen-finished with exquisite marble countertops and an inviting breakfast nook is illuminated by a large skylight. The principal bedroom-anchored by a bay window and decorative fireplace-includes an en-suite marble bath and an adjacent office/flex space. A spacious second bedroom, a full marble bath, and laundry complete this home. Above, an extensive attic accessible by pull-down ladder presents intriguing future potential. This exceptional offering in a charming yet cosmopolitan enclave places boutiques, restaurants, cafes, and the Presidio right at your doorstep.
